chapter: Wider talk: bands, places and players
title: Eating at Thompson's, Child's and Exchange Alley
summary: Musicians met for breakfast at Thompson's, and he recalls oyster sandwiches during Prohibition.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: No, no, no, that, but that's interesting that you would all gather in Thompson's. Sure. We all. I used to go there myself. Yeah, well.

What was that, about 20 years ago?
